svg.title: An ideas inbox with voting, before anything becomes a ticket — SoftTrack web design mockup (#280)
svg.desc: A suggestion becomes a ticket in the backlog or it is lost, and the person who suggested it never hears what happened. An idea is not a ticket: anyone signed in can submit one and vote, the team moves it through new, under consideration, planned, shipped or declined, and turning it into a ticket or an epic keeps the link.
svg.text: An ideas inbox with voting, before anything becomes a ticket
